use_case_summary: Origami EdgeWorks runs latency-sensitive conversational agents and document search across edge sites. Primary workloads: low-latency chat (p95 < 200ms for local sites), embedding generation for realtime indexing, and reranking for search. Must deploy Redwood Private in customer VPC with PrivateLink/endpoint service or VPC peering to avoid internet egress. Requirements: PrivateLink endpoints (AWS) or Transit Gateway peering for multi-AZ sites; IP allowlists with CIDR control; strict egress-only routing — all outbound traffic must go through corporate proxy and only to approved Redwood endpoints; firewall rules must allow TLS to specific ENIs/PrivateLink DNS names; no public IPs on inference hosts. KMS integration: customer-managed CMK with envelope encryption and key rotation policy; Redwood must show KMS usage pattern and key access logs. Audit logging: send inference audit logs and control-plane events to customer's Splunk/Syslog collector (S3 archives acceptable), with retention controls mapped to 7yr compliance profile. Data residency: primary EU region for EU customers, NA for US workloads; support for region-pin and model routing. Must complete security review (SRA) and provide ISO/SOC evidence before procurement.
